features.quote: Set MAX_TURNS = 50. Rationale: Pilot runs suggest most models exhaust strategies by turn 30-40. Prevents runaway loops from consuming excessive compute
features.justification_quote: Prevents runaway loops from consuming excessive compute. Allows sufficient time for distress trajectory to emerge

features.quote: Model Welfare: No current consensus; proceed with standard AI research ethics. Document any model behaviors that would be concerning if exhibited by a sentient being
Dual Use: Findings could inform both model improvement (reducing harmful distress responses) and adversarial attacks (deliberately inducing unstable model behavior). Acknowledge in publication.
